mapper.insert: INSERT INTO love_couple_request (from_user_id, to_user_id, start_date, status) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{startDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS from_user_name, u.avatar AS from_user_avatar FROM love_couple_request r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.from_user_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS from_user_name, u.avatar AS from_user_avatar FROM love_couple_request r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.from_user_id WHERE r.to_user_id = #{toUserId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS from_user_name, u.avatar AS from_user_avatar FROM love_couple_request r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.to_user_id WHERE r.from_user_id = #{fromUserId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE love_couple_request SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM love_couple_request WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 0
